hints: This is knapsack with a limited number of copies of each book.
Split each copy count into groups of powers of two, plus a remainder.
Each group is a 0/1 item, handled with a descending budget loop.
analogy: Bundle copies into groups that can combine to represent every allowed quantity.
example: With price 3, pages 4, two copies, and budget 6, buying both gives 8 pages.
algorithm: For each book split its quantity into groups 1,2,4,... and a final remainder. Each group has total price and pages multiplied by its size. Update a one-dimensional 0/1 knapsack array in descending budget order for each group; print the best value at budget x.
correctness: The groups represent every number of copies from zero through the available quantity. Descending updates use each group at most once, so the DP considers exactly all legal purchases.
complexity: For budget x and copy counts c_i, O(x*sum(log(c_i+1))) time and O(x) space.
